inventory_scope: Official OCW course-site sitemap inventory, not all MIT websites or paid/login materials

primary: Official native sources of included lecture notes
exclude: Third-party all-rights-reserved material without permission or justified exception

old_github_index.warning: Useful historical source metadata only; repository count is not current courses or notes count.

license.default: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless a material specifies otherwise
license.note: Private repository is not blanket clearance for unlicensed third-party copying/adaptation. Preserve credits and original per-file license; derivatives remain noncommercial/share-alike. No MIT endorsement claim/logos.

warnings: A course site can have no lecture notes, and one course may have many note files or multiple formats of the same content.
One complete PDF plus individual lecture PDFs must not double-count translated chapters.
Some native-looking PDFs have no distributed TeX; source availability must be verified.
Handwritten/scanned lecture notes exist, e.g. Simplicity Theory Spring2004 and Advanced Calculus for Engineers Fall2004.
Declared resource license may not detect embedded third-party material; inspect credit lines and PDFs/figures before translation/repository distribution.
